nodes.label: Deep-module design principle
nodes.rationale: A lot of behaviour behind a small interface, tested through that interface; each module reappears at 10+ call sites if deleted. Features render, mutate data and call save() — never touching persistence, sync, auth or the cloud directly; crossing that line means deepening a module, not adding a bypass.

nodes.label: Single-file frontend architecture
nodes.rationale: Vanilla ES module, no framework, no router, no build step; pages are sections toggled by switchTab(); rendering is innerHTML template literals + rebinding.

nodes.label: Personal namespace isolation (data.personal)
nodes.rationale: All personal data lives under one additive key data.personal so it inherits the existing cloud sync with zero schema/auth changes; Work code never reads data.personal and vice versa; normalize preserves unknown keys so 'personal' survives round-trips through older deployed clients; a bug in one namespace must never take the other down.

nodes.label: Whole-blob last-write-wins sync
nodes.rationale: One JSON blob (work + personal) synced by updatedAt; deterministic but the loser's concurrent edit is dropped — mitigated by the truthful sync pill.

nodes.label: Work / Personal mode switch
nodes.rationale: Device-level UI preference in localStorage psm_mode_v1, deliberately NOT in the synced blob; sets html[data-mode] and swaps nav, palette and page set.
